source_document: Canal de Isabel II: Captación (13 embalses, 6 azudes, acuíferos) and the treatment-plant sheets (ETAP), procedencia del agua
notes: Canal de Isabel II is described at two levels: the whole system (ES030-CYII) and each treatment plant (ES030-CYII-<PLANT>) with the sources its sheet lists. Urban units of the Tajo plan link to a plant when the plan names that part of the network (tanks, canals, plant), otherwise to the whole system.
